classification: Diagnostic CDP allocation dump during the offline supporting residency interval; not an uninstrumented idle gate. No forced GC (deterministic:false). Allocator categories overlap and must not be summed.
hypothesis: Inspector network response retention may contribute to the renderer footprint, but disconnecting automation did not reduce the immediate private-commit sample. Buffer ownership and longer-term retention remain unresolved; do not attribute the whole footprint to live React state or instrumentation alone.

observerControl.note: One paired diagnostic found higher private commit with Playwright attached. Separate controls show substantial GPU-process variation, so this is supporting evidence of observer overhead, not a stable causal estimate or an explanation of the entire full-workload footprint.
